title: egress-taper-probationary-circuit-triage-and-kv-sync-hotfix
author: Ava Chen
release_notes: Fix: Reduce cross-region egress storms by introducing an egress taper; Fix: probationary circuit state to avoid flip-flop during rejoin; Fix: KV sync race during node drain; Observability: add telemetry for probationary circuit transitions.
description:
Context:
During a P0 on 2026-02-10 we observed a correlated egress surge from a small set of customers that caused downstream egress quotas to be exceeded in secondary regions and triggered mass circuit trips and rapid reopen/close cycles. Root causes identified were: (1) no gradual egress reduction path during regional failover, (2) circuit state machine immediately reopens on partial health signals leading to flapping, and (3) KV cache drift during node drains produced a burst of KV sync traffic.

This PR bundles three complementary fixes as a hotpatch to stabilize regional failovers and reduce SLO pressure: 1) an egress taper that gracefully reduces cross-region egress contribution when downstream egress budgets are constrained; 2) a probationary circuit state (PROBATION) that requires sustained healthy probes before fully reopening to prevent flips; 3) a KV sync race fix to gate full KV rehydrate bursts during evacuation.

Goals and constraints:
- Minimize blast radius; changes are opt-in via feature flags and a conservative default config matching current behavior.
- Restore SLO headroom for affected regions without wholesale request drops.
- Preserve low-latency fast-path for healthy nodes.

Summary of changes (high level):
- runtime/egress_taper.go: new egress taper controller implementing token-decay and soft-cap per-tenant egress fraction when downstream egress is saturated.
- circuit/probationary_state.go: add PROBATION state with time-windowed probe counting and exponential backoff on probe frequency.
- slo/enforcer.go: small delta to account for egress-constrained weighting when computing soft-throttle budgets.
- kv/sync_adapter.go: gate full-sync by adding a staggered backoff and per-node rehydrate watermark; fix race where multiple nodes could request full rehydrates concurrently.
- telemetry/metrics.yaml: metrics and label additions to track probationary transitions and taper events.
- integration-tests/egress_taper_test.go: deterministic scenarios for egress taper behavior under sudden downstream budget exhaustion.
- docs/rfc/egress-taper.md: design rationale and configuration knobs.
- deploy/helm/values-production.yaml: feature flag and sane defaults for rollout.

Checklist:
- [x] Unit tests for new state machine (circuit/probationary_state_test.go)
- [x] Integration test simulating downstream egress saturation and verifying taper reduces cross-region egress
- [x] Telemetry added with tags for tenant and region
- [x] Feature-flag gated rollout and documented knobs in RFC

- 7c9d2b3: introduce egress taper controller and config knobs
- 3abf6e1: add PROBATION circuit state and probe logic + tests
- a1f4b88: kv sync gate and staggered rehydrate implementation
- 9e0d4f2: hook slo enforcer to include egress-weighted budgets

Review conversation (high level):
- Diego Martinez (request changes): "We need a metric that counts probationary probe rejections per tenant and an opt-out for enterprise customers in Dedicated clusters. Also please add one more unit test for backoff doubling edge-case."
- Ava Chen (author): "Added metrics.counter('probation.rejections') and a Dedicated-cluster opt-out flag in values-production.yaml. Added the requested backoff edge-case test."
- Priya Kapoor (comment): "KV rehydrate gating looks good; please ensure stagger window is randomized per node to avoid synchronized rehydrates."
- Ava Chen: "Implemented per-node randomized jitter; added deterministic jitter in tests for reproducibility."
- Liam O'Neill (approve): "Behavior looks sane; integration tests reproduce the incident pattern and demonstrate recovery without global drops. Approving to merge as hotfix."

CI summary:
- build: pass
- unit-tests: pass
- integration-tests: initially failed on timing-sensitive test (flake), re-run passed
- lint: pass with one docstring nit fixed in follow-up commit

Rollout plan:
1) Merge to main as feature-flag off.
2) Canary in a single low-traffic region with feature-flag on at 1% of traffic for 2 hours.
3) Ramp to 25% over 6 hours while validating probationary transition rates and no increased error rates.
4) Full rollout after 24h of stability or rollback on regression.

Post-merge actions:
- SRE runbook updated with new alert thresholds for probationary.rejections and egress.taper.rate
- Dashboard added (telemetry/egress-taper-dashboard) and linked in release notes

Why this is different from previous approaches:
Instead of a blunt global admission gate we implement a soft egress taper combined with a probationary circuit that holds reopened nodes in a guarded state until sustained healthy probes are observed. The combination reduces the amplitude of egress spikes while avoiding prolonged blackouts for tenants. The KV rehydrate gating addresses a secondary contributor to the burst.

Related work:

- prior transient circuit fixes (see PRs: pr-272800, pr-317890)

Merge: Squash and merge to main.
